description: §47.1.1 (S457 "a for __scrml_") — the `__scrml_` identifier namespace is reserved like `_scrml_`. The program declares `__scrml_cfg__` and references it; each is E-NAME-COLLIDES-RESERVED-PREFIX, reported once per line. (-pos: the code fires.)
rationale: §47.1.1 S457 ruling: a user-authored scrml program SHALL NOT declare or reference a name that begins with `__scrml_` — the namespace of the compiler's internal placeholders and locals — under E-NAME-COLLIDES-RESERVED-PREFIX. This is what lets the §2.2.1 emitted-artifact gate refuse any `__scrml_<name>__` identifier by shape alone.
